title: Meet Hep Gimble

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: Enjoying the flowers?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Enjoying the flowers?

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: The flowers. The plants. They’re quite lovely.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The flowers. The plants. They’re quite lovely.

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: You know... I can't exactly recall.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know... I can't exactly recall.

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: Oh, well I was never allowed to keep any of my memories, dear.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, well I was never allowed to keep any of my memories, dear.

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: It was an order. Part of the training. When we were told to forget, we forgot. I got quite good at it. Forgot every single one of my missions.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It was an order. Part of the training. When we were told to forget, we forgot. I got quite good at it. Forgot every single one of my missions.

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: Yes, when we went to find a target. There were always so many things to wash afterwards. I don’t remember the missions but I do remember the washing. Hands, uniform, tools... all that sterile spray would sting my skin something rotten.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, when we went to find a target. There were always so many things to wash afterwards. I don’t remember the missions but I do remember the washing. Hands, uniform, tools... all that sterile spray would sting my skin something rotten.

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: Who did you say you were, dear?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who did you say you were, dear?

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: That’s good. It’s one of the nicest jobs in the city. I wish I’d known keeping plants tidy was a job when I was young.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That’s good. It’s one of the nicest jobs in the city. I wish I’d known keeping plants tidy was a job when I was young.

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: LOOK at these flowers. This is the only place they’ll grow outside the Spire. How lucky we are to see them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: LOOK at these flowers. This is the only place they’ll grow outside the Spire. How lucky we are to see them.

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: My parents said CorpSec was a safe choice. I thought I’d be a paper pusher, but I was always athletic. I shouldn't have been surprised that the Corp promoted me to wetwork.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My parents said CorpSec was a safe choice. I thought I’d be a paper pusher, but I was always athletic. I shouldn't have been surprised that the Corp promoted me to wetwork.

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: I don't know. But their scent sticks to everything. Not even sterilizer gets rid of it. I sometimes smell it in the middle of the night.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know. But their scent sticks to everything. Not even sterilizer gets rid of it. I sometimes smell it in the middle of the night.

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: I’m tired now, dear. Don’t you have watering to see to?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’m tired now, dear. Don’t you have watering to see to?

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: "CorpSec". I think I worked for them, once.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "CorpSec". I think I worked for them, once.

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: I thought I’d be a paper pusher, but I was always athletic. I shouldn't have been surprised that the Corp promoted me to wetwork.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I thought I’d be a paper pusher, but I was always athletic. I shouldn't have been surprised that the Corp promoted me to wetwork.

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: I sometimes pick some of the flowers and press their blossoms between the pages of old books.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I sometimes pick some of the flowers and press their blossoms between the pages of old books.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, I came here to see them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, I came here to see them.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah, I came here to see them.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah, I came here to see them.

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: Some of them aren't real, you know, but the gardeners do such a nice job keeping the leaves freshly painted.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Some of them aren't real, you know, but the gardeners do such a nice job keeping the leaves freshly painted.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you do with the old books?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you do with the old books?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you do with the old books?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you do with the old books?

nodes.speaker: Hepzibah Gimble
nodes.text: You know... I'm not quite certain. Maybe I even read them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know... I'm not quite certain. Maybe I even read them.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you doing here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Missions?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Missions?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why did you need to sterilize anything?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why did you need to sterilize anything?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why did you need to sterilize anything?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why did you need to sterilize anything?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm a gardener. I just started.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm a gardener. I just started.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm a gardener. I just started.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm a gardener. I just started.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm from CorpSec.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm from CorpSec.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What did you do instead?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What did you do instead?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are they called?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are they called?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: To what?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: To what?!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Were you an assassin?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Were you an assassin?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like your conscience getting the better of you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like your conscience getting the better of you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds like your conscience getting the better of you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds like your conscience getting the better of you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You don't remember why you're here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't remember why you're here?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You don't remember why you're here?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You don't remember why you're here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Doing what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Doing what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You don't remember exactly?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't remember exactly?
